Name: Expanded Vanilla Crops
Author: richardba
Description:
[center][size=6][img]https://richardba.github.io/img/evc.png[/img]﻿
Expanded Vanilla Crops[/size][/center]
Transform your Stardew Valley farming experience by growing crops from foraged items you already know and love!

[size=5][b]Overview
[/b][/size]
This mod adds [b]plantable versions[/b] of vanilla foraged items, allowing you to cultivate wild plants, mushrooms, flowers, and fruits on your farm. No more relying on seasonal foraging - grow them yourself!

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]🌱 Plantable Crops[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Vegetables[/b]: Wild Horseradish, Leek, Spring Onion, Cave Carrot, Fiddlehead Fern, Ginger, Winter Root, Snow Yam, Moss
[*][b]Berries[/b]: Salmonberry, Blackberry, Spice Berry, Sweet Pea
[*][b]Mushrooms[/b]: Common Mushroom, Red Mushroom, Purple Mushroom, Chanterelle, Morel, Magma Cap
[*][b]Flowers[/b]: Daffodil, Dandelion, Crocus
[*][b]Bush Tree Fruits[/b]: Hazelnut, Plum, Holly, Crystal Fruit
[/list]
[size=4][b]🌳 New Fruit Trees[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Coconut Tree[/b]: Produces coconuts year-round
[*][b]Walnut Tree[/b]: Produces walnuts in summer with a chance for Golden Walnuts [i](configurable)[/i]
[/list]
[size=4][b]🔬 Seed Maker Integration[/b][/size]
All foraged items can be processed in the [b]Seed Maker[/b] to create their plantable versions:

[b]For most foraged items:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]97%[/b] chance for the intended seed/spore
[*][b]2%[/b] chance for Mixed Seeds
[*][b]1%[/b] chance for Ancient Seeds
[/list]
[b]For certain foraged items that compete with seasonal seeds:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]70%[/b] chance for the intended seed/spore
[*][b]27%[/b] chance for seasonal mixed seeds (Spring/Summer/Fall/Winter Seeds)
[*][b]2%[/b] chance for Mixed Seeds
[*][b]1%[/b] chance for Ancient Seeds
[/list]
[i]Examples: Wild Horseradish, Spice Berry, Common Mushroom, and Winter Root use the second system[/i]

[size=4][b]⭐ Rare Stardrop Crop[/b] [i](Optional)[/i][/size]
[list]
[*]Ultra-rare [b]year-long crop[/b] that yields a single Stardrop
[*][b]Limited to one per save file[/b]
[*]Must be enabled in config [i](disabled by default)[/i]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

The mod includes a [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file with the following options:

[code]
{
"Enable Stardrop Crop": "false",
"Enable Walnut Tree": "true"
}
[/code]

[list]
[*][b]Enable Stardrop Crop[/b]: Adds the rare Stardrop crop [i](default: false)[/i]
[*][b]Enable Walnut Tree[/b]: Adds the Walnut fruit tree [i](default: true)[/i]
[/list]
[size=5][b]How to Get Seeds[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*][b]Forage[/b] the original items in their natural locations
[*][b]Process them[/b] in a Seed Maker to get plantable seeds/spores
[*][b]Plant and grow[/b] them on your farm like regular crops
[/list]
[b]Alternative:[/b] Starting in Year 2, seeds and spores can also be purchased from various shops for convenience.

[b]Fruit Trees:[/b] Purchase saplings from Pierre's or JojaMart. Additionally, Palm trees in Calico Desert and Ginger Island have a chance to yield Coconut Saplings when shaken or chopped.

[size=5][b]Seasonal Growing[/b][/size]

Most crops follow logical seasonal patterns:
[list]
[*][b]Spring[/b]: Wild Horseradish, Leek, Spring Onion, Daffodil, etc.
[*][b]Summer[/b]: Spice Berry, Sweet Pea, Common Mushroom, etc.
[*][b]Fall[/b]: Blackberry, Hazelnut, Chanterelle, etc.
[*][b]Winter[/b]: Winter Root, Snow Yam, Crocus, etc.
[*][b]Year-round[/b]: Most mushrooms (in greenhouse)
[/list]
[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] required
[*][b]Content Patcher[/b] required
[*][b]SpaceCore[/b] required (for animations)
[*]Compatible with most other farming mods
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b], [b]Content Patcher[/b], and [b]SpaceCore[/b]
[*]Download and extract this mod to your [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder
[*]Launch the game and enjoy farming foraged items!
[/list]
[size=5][b]Credits[/b][/size]

Mod created for expanding the vanilla Stardew Valley farming experience while maintaining the game's original aesthetic and balance.

[i]Happy farming! 🌾[/i]
